extension.name: lkim3
extension.author: Aidan Technologies
extension.license: GNU General Public License version 2 or later
extension.description: Portal Rasmi LKIM - reka bentuk LKIM-3. Child of Cassiopeia, styled to SPLaSK / MyGovEA expectations, with the mega menu, audience gateways, service grid, gallery strip and agency carousel homepage layout.

field.name: stickyHeader
field.label: Sticky header
field.description: This design floats the header over the hero. Turn this on only if the header must stay visible while scrolling.

field.name: menuSource
field.label: Main menu source
field.description: "LKIM-3 design" draws the mega menu straight from the menu selected below, leaving the "menu" module position untouched.

field.name: heroImage
field.label: Hero image
field.description: Full-bleed background for the homepage hero. 1920x1080 or wider is recommended.

field.name: heroTitle
field.label: Hero heading
field.description: Leave empty to use the default from the language file. Wrap words in {a}...{/a} for the orange accent, and use {br} to force a line break.

field.name: bandSourceNote
field.label: Where each band gets its content
field.description: Every homepage band can draw its content either from the LKIM-3 design (the settings below) or from its module position. The design is the default, so the homepage matches the mockup as soon as the template is installed.

field.name: showServices
field.label: Services section
field.description: One feature card plus four supporting cards.

field.name: srcNews
field.label: News source
field.description: "LKIM-3 design" shows the portal's three most recent articles in this design's cards.

field.name: themeNote
field.label: These settings override the stylesheet
field.description: Every value here is written into the page as a CSS variable block that loads after lkim3.css, so the template can be recoloured entirely from this screen — no write access to the template files is needed. Clear a field to fall back to the stylesheet's own value.

field.name: cPrimary
field.label: Primary
field.description: Carries the header panels, the feature card, buttons on dark panels and most headings.

field.name: cPrimaryDark
field.label: Primary — darkest
field.description: Mega menu panel, footer background and heading text.

field.name: cAccent
field.label: Accent
field.description: Primary buttons, section markers and footer link hovers.

field.name: cSecondary
field.label: Secondary
field.description: Checklist ticks, mega menu bullets and card hover borders.

field.name: cSecondaryDark
field.label: Secondary — deep
field.description: Section eyebrows and "read more" links.

field.name: cHeroAccent
field.label: Hero accent
field.description: The highlighted words in the hero heading, the active nav item and the hero's primary button.

field.name: cSurface
field.label: Surface — page bands
field.description: Background of the news band and the agency logo tiles.

field.name: cSurfaceAlt
field.label: Surface — controls
field.description: The government identification bar and the header icon buttons.

field.name: cTextSubtle
field.label: Text — subtle
field.description: Section intros, card descriptions and dates.

field.name: cFocusRing
field.label: Keyboard focus ring
field.description: Keep this at a strong contrast against both light and dark backgrounds — it is an accessibility requirement, not decoration.

field.name: footerPattern
field.label: Footer pattern opacity
field.description: 0 hides the watermark pattern behind the footer, 1 shows it at full strength.

field.name: fontSource
field.label: Font source
field.description: "System fonts" makes no external request, which some agency networks require. The families below are then ignored in favour of the visitor's own UI font.

field.name: fontHeading
field.label: Heading font family
field.description: Family name as the font provider spells it, for example Manrope or Poppins.

field.name: fontHeadingWeights
field.label: Heading weights
field.description: Semicolon-separated, for the Google Fonts request.

field.name: fontFallback
field.label: Fallback stack
field.description: Used while the web font loads, and instead of it if the request fails.

field.name: baseSize
field.label: Base text size
field.description: Any CSS length. The accessibility controls scale up from whatever is set here.

field.name: wrapWidth
field.label: Content width
field.description: Maximum width of the centred column. Ignored while Portal > Content width is set to Full width.

field.name: sectionPad
field.label: Space above and below each band

field.name: radiusLg
field.label: Corner radius — large
field.description: Feature card, complaints banner.

field.name: radiusMd
field.label: Corner radius — medium
field.description: Service cards, news cards, gateway cards, gallery items.

field.name: heroFocus
field.label: Hero image focal point
field.description: A CSS object-position value. "78% center" keeps the right of the photo in view; use "center" to centre it, or "30% top" to favour the upper left.

field.name: heroShade
field.label: Hero image shading
field.description: 0 leaves the photo untouched, 1 is fully shaded. The hero text needs enough shading behind it to stay readable — check the contrast after changing this.

field.name: showGovBanner
field.label: Government portal identification bar
field.description: The "Portal Rasmi Kerajaan Malaysia" bar, with the official JDN / MyGovEA wording.

field.name: showAccessBar
field.label: Accessibility controls (text size + contrast)
field.description: Shown in the header behind the accessibility icon.

field.name: splaskAttribute
field.label: SPLaSK marker attribute
field.description: The HTML attribute name used to mark SPLaSK elements. Change it to whatever the current circular specifies if that differs.

field.name: showFooterContact
field.label: "Contact us" column in the footer
field.description: The built-in address column, which carries the SPLaSK markers. Turn it off if a footer module already lists the same address.

field.name: agencyAddress
field.default: Aras 1-12, Wisma LKIM, Pulau Meranti, 47120 Puchong, Selangor
field.label: Agency address

field.name: customCodeNote
field.label: This code runs on every page
field.description: Both fields below are written to the page exactly as entered, with no filtering. Keep "Edit" permission on com_templates with Super Users only. For anything substantial, use the user.css / user.js files below so the code stays under version control.

field.name: customCss
field.label: Custom CSS
field.description: Loaded after lkim3.css, so it overrides the template without needing !important. Do not include <style> tags.

field.name: customJs
field.label: Custom JavaScript
field.description: Do not include <script> tags, and avoid strings containing </script>.

field.name: customJsPosition
field.label: Custom JavaScript position
field.description: "End of body" runs after the page is drawn and is right for almost all code. Choose "In head" only for code that must run earlier, such as a measurement tag.

field.name: useUserFiles
field.label: Load user.css / user.js
field.description: Loads media/templates/site/lkim3/css/user.css and js/user.js when they exist. Missing files are skipped silently.
